Before you ask.
You can create assessment workflows, invite candidates, receive completion events and bring scores and reports back into your own product.
The API is designed for ATS, HRIS, LMS, EdTech and other products that need skills, coding or job-role assessments inside an existing workflow.
Yes. Webhooks can notify your system when key assessment events occur so status and result updates can move automatically.
The integration can be designed around your product workflow, with Xobin handling the assessment layer and returning the information your application needs.
